body.x: GoDirectinc(www.godirectinc.com) unveiled ipad mini case 'Roocase' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
It made by genuine leather with micro suede interior, and detachable inner sleeve for handheld operation. sleeve reattaches to folio by Velcro for landscape or portrait viewing.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
